reviews.text: I love this company; my experience with them is always pleasing. All their groomers are very professional. I almost always ask for Mafer, and she makes my dog ​​look beautiful. She's truly excellent; my Lola always comes out looking beautiful and relaxed.
María Fernanda took care of me yesterday, and my dogs looked amazing! Excellent service. I highly recommend her.
Mafer's service was excellent, I was more than satisfied with the haircut and she was very kind to the dog, 10/10 service!
I love the way my dogs look. I will always continue to use Mafer services.
Yasmin did a great job! It was my first time using your services and I will definitely be a returning customer.
It took 4 hours for my dog ​​to be ready... while the other dogs weren't very happy...

My groomer is usually Karol and I’m just used to the home visits I do prefer them so first of all thank you Karol for all the home visits we are missing you. Today Mike came to the rescue and did a fine job. Thank you so much Poochi for loving my Dog and making her so pretty.

I can’t say enough great things about POOCHIE on the Block! Mary and her entire team are absolutely amazing. Every single time I bring my boys in, they do an exceptional job and have them looking fantastic. You can immediately tell how much care, patience, and attention to detail they put into their work.

What means the most to me is how comfortable and excited my boys are to go there. They genuinely look forward to seeing Mary and the team, which says everything about how well they’re treated. It gives me complete peace of mind knowing they’re in the hands of people who truly care about the dogs they work with.

The service is consistently excellent, the team is friendly and professional, and the quality of their grooming never disappoints. If you’re looking for groomers who will treat your dogs like their own and have them coming home looking their absolute best, I highly recommend POOCHIE on the Block. Mary and her team have definitely earned my trust and loyalty! 10/10! 🐶❤️

Maribel did my mini poodle Bert’s  mobile grooming! She did an amazing job! He was needing a professional grooming since I had been cutting his hair since he was a puppy. He was wagging his tail and happy after the full grooming. Will ask for Maribel again and the experience was great with the groomer. She came on time and was quick
I have a 3-pound Yorkie with a bad leg, and this is the only place I trust with my baby girl. They take such gentle, loving care of her and always leave her looking fabulous. Truly the BEST!

Always very positive, attentive , understanding with the dogs especially with Mila, she’s very skilled at grooming, claws, eyes, ears annd glands done as necessary; and Charlie loves her. I will always come back. Calum
Mila  and Marco did a wonderful job on our dog. They are precise and sweet. Pays attention to detail!!
I’ve been trusting Poochie with my precious teacup poodle for over 15 years. They are wonderfully caring groomers and I highly recommend them!
I am very grateful for the service provided by Yasmin, an excellent person, very kind and patient, an excellent professional. We recommend her 100%.

It has been 4 or 5 times now that my doggie has been groomed at the store front location. They always do an amazing job and take her in almost every time without an appointment, which for me is huge considering I am never prepared for anything LOL. Today she was groomed by Mary and bathed by Marco, they did a phenomenal job! They went above and beyond and made her look like a good Mini Schnauzer should. This should be your one stop shop and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality and shine on your pups.

This is the first time I've brought my pet here, and Cappuccino felt incredibly pampered. They treated him very well, and best of all, he came out looking cuter than ever. Mari did a great job. Here's a picture of how he turned out! Highly recommended!
Yazmin is always excellent with my senior dog of 16 years! Always pleasant and patient!

I always have a great experience at the salon Poochie on the Block.  I’ve been bringing my dog for years. He’s always happy to come inside (that’s always a good sign). I love how easily I can make an appointment with them, they know my dog for his name.  Mila is always so sweet and takes good care of my dog. She’s always asking about how our family is doing, great customer service. Plus the spray they put on my dog smells great! Definitely bring your pets here ☺️
They're excellent. My dog ​​has a lot of allergies, and they treat her wonderfully here at the salon. Marcos and Mila take great care of Luna, and she's improved so much. Thank you so much!

First time client. Made an appointment with Poochie’s mobile service. My dog was groomed by Jasmin. I have a 7 month old goldendoodle and she was very patient with him. She listened to my requests and followed through with a fabulous cut for my sweet boy!
Very happy costumer! Jasmin is great!
Yasmin is the best! And sweetest with our girl! Highly recommend!!
@Mari Thank you so much for the service, I'm very grateful for everything, excellent service, friendly haircut
Yasmin is the best of the best! My puppy loves her and is excited to get groomed by her. I would recommend her every day! We love her!
Jasmine came to our house to groom our 2 dogs & was so patient with them & left them looking their best! We have been using Poochy for a long time & will continue. ❤️
Jasmine has been grooming our dog for a year and she’s the best there is - thank you!!
Joy, I had service with Jasmin and I loved her service, she is super friendly
My Lola looked beautiful

Poochie on Your Block always provides a wonderful grooming experience for Sophie. Maria Fernanda was my latest groomer. She arrived on time and she did a great job! She trimmed Sophie’s nails (which are black in color) perfectly. Sophie’s haircut and paws are very nicely done. Sophie was happy, which makes me happy and confident in their grooming service.

This was my first time visiting Poochie On Your Block, but it certainly won't be my last. Mila did an excellent job with our Goldendoodle, Hemi. My son, mom, and husband all love the style. My mom said she's very professional. My son said it's the best grooming he's ever had. Thank you, Mila, for your attention to detail and the care you give our baby. 🙏
They did an excellent job and took time and care with our dog. Highly recommend.

Updated: for two years my lovely Cloud has been groomed by Karol (he still doing a amazing job) but today who came was Yasmin...omg she is from other 🌎,  she is absolutely professional, caring and a sweet woman who know how to do her job.  My Cloud look so beautiful.  Thank you Yasmin!!!

After 2 years tried diferent grooming services, finally I found out the best! This is the second time using their services and I'm absolutely happy with the result,  Karol made a terrific, amazing job with my Cloud. He is very kind and take care of my baby in the best way that he can. And also they have great prices. Absolutely recommended.
Poochie on your block has fantastic customer service. And they do a wonderful job. Luna loves her spa days. 🙌

Yasmin was amazing! She’s incredibly professional and truly dedicated to her work. I’ve tried many groomers in the past where I felt uneasy leaving my dog, but with her I never have to think twice. My pup is always in great hands!
Yasmin did an excellent job with my Shih Tzu. She is very caring, professional and listened to my concerns and needs. She took her time not to make my dog nervous. Will book her service again.
They cut my dog’s ear, I took him out of there bleeding and they sent me a text saying that they did a little cut. Never going back to this place again.

I’ve gotten my senior mini golden doodle mobile groomed with Cindy for the past few months and I could not be happier. She is so kind, she is great at haircuts, and she does a wonderful, quick job. 10/10 recommend Poochie On Your Block & Cindy!

The groomer did a very bad job and completely destroyed our Bichon’s haircut. Obviously did not have any training and did not anything about a Bichon haircut. I reached out to the owner, Norma, to let her know we were very disappointed and she never even responded. Extremely bad service.

First time and it was a wonderful experience. They were so friendly and understanding. Definitely our place for our baby dorkie Rocky! I also loved their available harnesses and sets , got a few for him and our other fur baby Daisy! Look forward to working with them again on a monthly basis!

This was the first time I've used this mobile service and I'm delighted. I got an appointment very quickly. Yasmin did a great job with my Cavapoo, who needed a lot of hair removed. She listened to me, asked questions, was honest, and very kind. The price is fair, and having them come to my home is convenient. I absolutely recommend it!

Absolutely disappointed with Poochie On Your Block Mobile Grooming. My corgi’s haircut was completely botched — uneven, choppy, and nothing like what I requested. To make matters worse, there was zero apology from the owner, no offer for a refund or even a discount. The owner showed no concern for the mistake and made it clear that customer satisfaction isn’t a priority. If you care about your pet’s appearance and comfort, I’d highly recommend looking elsewhere. This was a costly and frustrating experience I won’t be repeating!!!

My puppy cookie ran away for a few days. I got her back in the worst conditions she had gotten fleas terrible not I have a Shih Tzu 13 month old and extremely dirty. I barely recognized her but I recommend 110%. These groomers are dedicated devoted they have gone above and beyond and I’m lost of words for how Happy I was with their service. Thank you so much. You guys are amazing.
Yazmin is the best! Takes her time, does exactly what you ask her to do. I have a goldendoodle and she does the perfect cut. She is extremely sweet with him! I recommend them 100 percent
Thank you
The work was excellent, my baby girl looks beautiful, thanks to Maria Frenada, a very kind young woman, thank you for your beautiful work
Thank you
Excellent, on time,  professional, very knowledgeable, dogs happy and perfectly groomed , highly recommended. Yasmin is the best !!!

Isys at Poochie on your block has been the only person I have allowed to groom my senior pets. She comes to my house in the company’s van to groom my dog and has been doing this for several years. My dog does not always get along with everyone, but with Isys, he goes like being with family. Isys also groomed my cat until she passed away. My beautiful (angel) Persian cat had long hair and was not easy to groom, but with Isys, she was calm, and Isys managed to leave her looking beautiful. I have seen how loving she is to animals; she is gentle and sweet to the animals. I absolutely recommend her to anyone looking for a caring groomer.

I was hesitant to have our new rescue groomed, but I had gotten really good feedback from other neighbors that had used this company for their pups.  I am so happy I scheduled an appointment and was fortunate to have Yazmin as our groomer.  She did an awesome job with our fur baby.  We got a full groom and will definitely call them again (requesting Yazmin),  when it’s time for Jessy’s haircut.  Thank you Yazmin for being so kind and patient with our baby 💗🐶 before and after pics enclosed!
Thank you

Please do not take your dog here for grooming. They had given my dog a severe ULCER in the eye that the veterinarian said was one of the biggest they had ever seen in that type of dog (Bichon frise and Shih Tzu mix) , and that it will need triple medication just to make sure it doesn't get infected and lose his eye. And on top of that, they have the audacity to try and argue over the phone claiming that WE were ok with it. For the safety of your dog (and your wallet for that matter) PLEASE do not take your dog to this place.
Thank you

Had Yazmin come to my house and create a miracle on my golden doodle! Wow she is amazing and honestly so sweet! Felt so comfortable leaving my puppy with her and at the end my puppy didn’t want to leave her! She’s amazing see you in 3 weeks!!
Thank you

It was my first time with POOCHIE on the Block, and Yasmin was recommended by two friends. Yasmin was amazing with my CaliBear! 🐶 She was super detailed in explaining her process and with the styling. I’m super happy and I’ll definitely be recommending her and POOCHIE to more friends and family! …
Best groomers I have ever been to! They did an amazing job with my French bulldog and extreme attention to detail. 10/10
Yazmin has taken great care of our shih tzu a couple times. He has some joint and skin issues as he gets older and she is very considerate to them. Haircut looks great!!

Took my golden retriever to this grooming place, and I couldn’t be happier with how he turned out. The groomers were friendly and took good care of him. He came out looking neat, and they even put a cute little bow on him. The only downside is that it’s hard to get an appointment, but that’s because they’re so good.
Great people

They are very sweet and love the pets.
Thank you so much,
Great service by Yasmin!! She did great and always leaves Lola Flores beautiful!!
Five stars! Jasmin is the best! Takes such good care of my baby!

Yasmin was amazing!! She took the time and showed me what the different blades looked like and explained the different lengths to me to know how I wanted my dogs hair to be groomed. She was very professional and my dog looks amazing! I highly recommend booking with Yasmin!
Poochie is so great! I gave them a call today and everything was set up within 2 hours! What a great service, they come to you and finish within an hour! Great service!
Thanks again Jazmin for my fur baby’s hair cut. See you again soon!
Thank you

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an excellent experience with Poochie on your block. Yasmine was the best groomer ! She was punctual and arrived on time. The groomer truly understood my dog’s needs and ensured she was comfortable throughout the process. Her amazing personality made the entire experience pleasant for both me and my pet. Highly recommend!
I'm extremely happy with the work they did for my expert; I recommend them to everyone.
I loved how my dog's teeth turned out, we are happy with the service, they don't use anesthesia, the process was not stressful at all for my dog, I highly recommend them, their work is excellent.
